objective: Validate a three-agent task where two senders hold complementary private coordinates and the receiver must combine both messages to identify one row. Then, only after passing resource and disjoint calibration gates, compare message representations with schedule and call structure fixed.
task_family: Complete Cartesian product [q] x [q] with q a power of two >= 2; hidden target uniform over q^2 rows; Sender X sees only x, Sender Y sees only y, and Receiver sees the candidate table only.

exact_references.zero_error_bound_scope: simultaneous noiseless fixed-width binary message from each coordinate source; framing, prompts, model decoding, and setup excluded

role_views.sender_x: q and the hidden target's x-coordinate only
role_views.sender_y: q and the hidden target's y-coordinate only

terminal_submission.count_as: model inference call and scored answer; not an inter-agent transmission

primary_outcomes: sum delivered application bytes for both messages
all sender and receiver input/output tokens and model calls

protocol_freeze.parser_policy: compact_kv and strict_json require exact canonical strings; fixed_binary requires exactly log2(q) bits; concise_nl syntax and semantic fidelity remain undecidable by the deterministic parser and are reported null pending a separately frozen blinded judging procedure.
protocol_freeze.execution_gate: No inference until model IDs, tokenizer IDs, endpoint settings, resource preflight, and disjoint perfect full-information ledger are supplied and validated.

natural_language_baseline: The frozen concise_nl arm is a feasibility baseline, not an optimized natural-language baseline. Develop an optimized arm only on a seed-disjoint development shard, freeze it before evaluation, and charge prompt-selection calls and inputs to setup/inference cost. Do not claim a primary representation ranking against optimized natural language until that work is complete.
fixed_code_semantics: For q=2^w, encode each coordinate index as exactly w bits in its sender slot. The fixed schedule identifies which slot is x or y. Count protocol instructions and codebook exposition in model input tokens; measure delivered payload and envelope bytes separately.
analysis: Pair all representation arms by episode_id and keep all preregistered held-out episodes. Report exact task-level discordances and descriptive uncertainty only for this pilot. Do not use the capability calibration ledger to filter evaluation tasks. Treat the three format contrasts as one exploratory family and correct or explicitly label unadjusted p-values. Plot success against both delivered channel bytes and complete inference tokens; do not combine unlike tokenizers or collapse the two budgets into one score.
capability_gate: Before any comparison call, the Receiver must answer every disjoint calibration episode correctly when supplied both exact coordinates. Calibration tasks must not occur in the evaluation shard.
resource_gate: Before any local model load or request, satisfy the repository's current same-host CPU/GPU/memory/port preflight, request timeout, hard call cap, and automatic-stop requirements. Each batch is limited to 12 planned model requests. A failed preflight stops before artifacts are loaded or endpoints contacted.
batching: Both-source representation conditions use at most four evaluation episodes per batch (4 x 3 calls = 12). Single-source conditions use at most six episodes per batch (6 x 2 calls = 12). No-message and full-information batches use at most 12 episodes. Every condition uses the same task manifest, evaluation IDs, models, endpoint settings, and decoding parameters where applicable.
prediction: If both source messages are required and the receiver is capability-qualified, full-inference success should exceed either one-source arm. Any representation ranking may vary with q and should be assessed after charging both source calls and receiver decoding. Fixed-width binary minimizes ideal payload bits but may lose after prompt, decoding, and model-error costs.
claim_limits: This deterministic Cartesian task is a calibration family, not a naturalistic collaboration benchmark.
The oracle bound does not predict LLM token efficiency or model success.
A single-q pilot cannot establish a scaling law or generalized language advantage.
Prompts and deterministic parsers are frozen, but endpoint/model settings remain pending; no inference has been run or is authorized by this preregistration alone.
expected_runtime: Pure Python standard library; task generation and analytic controls make no model or network calls.
